text:
[issue by ayson625]
### Description

Super glue just stopped applying at some random moment. It doesnt apply at all, like there is no green boxes, no visual or sound effect, absolutely nothing. But I found out that if i put super glue in left hand and block in right and try to place it, a block will be glued. I can still see glue contraption that I placed before this bug occured and I can break them. It's not a visual bug, I don't have shaders installed or smh. I tried placing it in another world, reload the game, play with the game settings but nothing works.

[comment by kkasandra290-bit (none)]
Hello,

I play on Feather Launcher and I use my own mod pack. I wanted to install the Create mod so I could build and use blueprints, because I play with a friend on another server and I really need this mod.
Unfortunately, I have a problem. I cannot find a working version of Create for Fabric on Minecraft 1.21.1, and Forge also does not work properly for me, even though I installed all the required files and patches needed for NeoForge to run it. Even so, it still does not work — I have all the required dependencies for the mod installed, but Forge/NeoForge still fails to run.
I also tried NeoForge separately, but it still does not work.
Other NeoForge mods work correctly, but Create is either not detected by the game or does not load at all, even when I use the correct version for Minecraft 1.21.1.
Could someone please help me figure out what I am doing wrong or provide a working solution or version of the mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric
Thank you very much.

[comment by VoidLeech (collaborator)]
Please don’t attempt to hijack unrelated issues. It is very easy to make your own if you have a legitimate issue.
This is also not the fabric repo, where you’d clearly find that Create Fabric 1.21.1 is being skipped. 
Idk how feather works but if they fail to work with Neoforge mods that’s a problem on their end.

[comment by VoidLeech (collaborator)]
@ayson625 can you try reproducing this with just Create?

[comment by Lumichi (none)]
@ayson625 there is also a bug for me with super glue, not exactly the same as yours, but might be connected (no pun intended)

like when using an extended sticky mechanical piston, like whenever I assemble any mechanical or minecart contraption, anything sticking to the front of the sticky mechanical piston will not get assembled with it. The only FIX I have found for now is to glue that block and the piston head block together to have it assembled together

[comment by ayson625 (none)]
@VoidLeech Thanks for feedback. Turns out that wasn't create issue at all. Problem solved after conversation with deepseek lol. It analyzes logs and recommend me to delete controlify, papi and redirected mods. I did so and problem vanished. Conflict was probably because of one of those mods

[comment by VoidLeech (collaborator)]
Put a plug in it was known to cause issues with the interfaces on the sides of blocks, good to know they break more than just that because I hadn't even considered checking for it. Love that.
Redirected I don't think is really recommended either due to it being a very unsafe change, but Controlify should cause you absolutely no trouble except in the cases where Create doesn't support it.
